question: Is there a discount code or a good deal on the ESR 100W 6-in-1 MagSafe charging station right now?
query: ESR 100W 6-in-1 MagSafe charging station discount code deal October 2026

rec.answer:
Yes. The best currently verified option in these results is code **PARTNER18** for **18% off ESR products** at ESR’s store. The 100W 6-in-1 station was listed at **$142.99**; the code brings it to about **$117.26** (roughly **$25.73 off**). The code was reported tested in ESR’s cart and listed as valid through **December 31, 2026** ([Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/)).

A better price appeared recently: **$64.99 at Amazon**, about 50% off—but that offer is marked **expired** ([Slickdeals](https://slickdeals.net/f/20194893-100w-gan-esr-6-in-1-magsafe-charging-station-w-cryoboost-64-99-free-shipping)). So PARTNER18 is a usable discount, but if you’re not in a hurry, it may be worth waiting for another deep sale.
